title: ANDESSENCE
subtitle: Commercial Website & Operations Platform
summary: A full-stack commercial platform combining multi-brand storefronts, online ordering, inventory management, and internal business operations.
cover_alt: ANDESSENCE commercial website and operations platform cover

overview.title: Overview
paragraphs: ANDESSENCE is a commercial platform developed for a multi-brand business, combining a customer-facing storefront with backend services and internal management tools.

The platform supports three sub-brands through dedicated brand pages, product catalogs, and an online ordering workflow. Behind the storefront, a FastAPI backend manages order processing, inventory reservation, and operational data, while an authenticated admin interface supports daily business activities.
The project covers the full development lifecycle, from translating business requirements into website design and system workflows to cloud deployment and ongoing maintenance.

responsibilities.title: Responsibilities
items: Gather business requirements and translate them into website features, data structures, and operational workflows.
Design and develop responsive storefront pages, brand presentations, product catalogs, and ordering interfaces using Vue 3 and TypeScript.
Develop REST APIs using FastAPI and PostgreSQL for order processing, inventory management, authentication, and business data.
Implement an authenticated admin interface for managing orders and reviewing products, inventory, KOLs, shipments, and operational records.
Integrate LINE Messaging API notifications, Google Forms backup, and KOL-specific ordering workflows.
Implement technical SEO, structured content organization, and responsive layouts across desktop and mobile devices.
Configure cloud deployment and automated delivery using Firebase Hosting, Cloud Run, Docker, and GitHub Actions.

technical_highlights.title: Technical Highlights
paragraphs: The platform integrates a multi-brand Vue storefront with a FastAPI backend and PostgreSQL database. Its order workflow validates product information and pricing against database records, reserves available inventory, and provides operational visibility through an authenticated management interface.

The frontend and backend are deployed independently, with automated deployment workflows supporting ongoing updates. External integrations extend the platform with order notifications, form backups, and KOL-specific ordering experiences.

items.title: Translating business operations into software
items.description: The business relied on manual order confirmation and fulfillment processes. Designing the platform required converting these activities into practical digital workflows without introducing unnecessary complexity.

items.title: Maintaining consistency across the ordering workflow
items.description: Orders involve product information, pricing, inventory availability, and payment and shipping statuses. Coordinating these elements required backend validation, transactional inventory updates, and clear operational state management.

items.title: Balancing brand presentation and system functionality
items.description: The storefront needed to communicate distinct brand identities while supporting product discovery and ordering. The implementation also had to remain responsive, maintainable, and adaptable to changing business requirements.

outcome.title: Outcome
paragraphs: The project delivered a deployed commercial platform connecting a multi-brand storefront with an operational backend and internal management interface.

Customers can explore products and submit orders online, while staff can review orders, update payment and shipping statuses, monitor inventory, and receive LINE notifications. The platform provides a foundation for ongoing business operations and incremental feature development.

lessons_learned.title: Lessons Learned
items: Understanding real business workflows is essential when translating requirements into practical software features.
Business-critical data such as pricing and inventory should be validated and controlled by the backend rather than trusted from frontend inputs.
Integrating frontend, backend, database, and external services requires clear data flows and consistent operational states.
Commercial software development involves balancing visual quality, business usability, delivery constraints, and long-term maintainability.
